SELECT board_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO board ( seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{id}, #{title}, #{text}, #{color}, #{body_shape}, #{image_uuid}, #{image_original}, #{image_url}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT b.seq, b.id, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, b.title, b.text, b.color, b.body_shape, b.image_uuid, b.image_original, b.image_url, b.created_at, b.like_count AS likeCount, b.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, b.read_count AS readCount, ( SELECT LISTAGG(t.tag, ' ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.seq) FROM board_tag t WHERE t.board_id = b.seq ) AS tag FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.id = m.id ORDER BY b.seq DESC

SELECT b.seq, b.id, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, b.title, b.text, b.color, b.body_shape, b.image_uuid, b.image_original, b.image_url, b.created_at, b.like_count AS likeCount, b.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, b.read_count AS readCount, ( SELECT LISTAGG(t.tag, ' ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.seq) FROM board_tag t WHERE t.board_id = b.seq ) AS tag FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.id = m.id WHERE b.seq = #{seq}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE board SET dislike_count = dislike_count - 1 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND dislike_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, read_count AS readCount FROM ( SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count, dislike_count, read_count FROM board ORDER BY like_count DESC, created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
